text:
anya: Drafted a compact SI onboarding syllabus focused on HW partner enablement + marketplace listing process. Linking doc — need quick review before Friday. @samir @jess any initial thoughts?

samir: Thanks! Can we add a hands-on lab for appliance installs? Partners often get stuck on network/driver steps.

jess: Love the lab idea. Also recommend a 20-min cert check: config + smoke test + roleplay. Keeps it lightweight. :white_check_mark:

michael: Timing/owners? Quick Q — will cert be free or paid? Marketplace listing requires partner attestation.

anya: Draft currently says free for the first cohort, then paid proctoring for maintenance renewals. Listing attestation is a legal item — looping them. Added TODOs in the doc.

samir: For hardware partners, can we include a short troubleshooting cheat sheet and a sample `support.json` manifest they can copy? Low friction.

jess: +1. Also propose two cert tracks: Integrator (deployment) and Integrations (app dev). Different badges and rubric.

michael: Rollout idea: pilot with 8–10 SIs in May, then scale via recorded labs + monthly live QA sessions.

onboard-bot: New doc uploaded: https://redwood.docs/sis-onboard-syllabus-v1 (access: partnerships) :link:

anya: Minimal curriculum snippet (in doc):
```
Week 1: Intro + infra checklist (access, keys, network)
Week 2: HW install lab (appliance + drivers + KV cache)
Week 3: Marketplace listing walkthrough (attestation + assets)
Week 4: Cert assessment & roleplay (smoke tests + support handoff)
```
Any missing items?

samir: Please add KV cache troubleshooting and model quantization notes for edge devices — those are frequent escalation points.

jess: Assessment rubric note: pass/fail plus detailed feedback matrix. I can draft the rubric and sample questions.

michael: Can we tie incentives — e.g., priority marketplace placement for certified SIs? That'll motivate completion.

anya: Agreed — adding priority listing and partner badge as benefits. I'll also add a short legal attestation template and flag to legal.

samir: Can we schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize the pilot cohort? 10:00am PT works for me.

jess: Works for me — please send the invite.

michael: I'm in. Thanks everyone, see you tomorrow.
